subject: Final acceptance gate, signature routing and proposed Day 1 start window
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final acceptance gate, signature routing and proposed Day 1 start window

Samir — attaching the updated MAP and a compact SOW for your legal/procurement review (Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf; SOW_Acme_v1.docx).

High level ask: can Acme confirm the final internal approvals and preferred signature routing by EOD tomorrow so we can schedule the DocuSign packet and lock a Day 1 start window the week of Aug 11 (preferred) or Aug 18 (fallback)?

Key items in the MAP:
- Acceptance criteria: performance (99th pctl <= 220ms for the primary routes), data handling notes, and latency SLA triggerpoints.
- Approvals: Security signoff (SOC 2 evidence agreed), Procurement (T&Cs redlines), Exec sponsor for start date.
- Signature routing options: single-signer (Procurement + Exec in one packet) or split (Procurement first, then Exec). DocuSign link below will support either flow.

If procurement needs an extra cycle, propose we still collect Exec verbal signoff and hold the Day 1 slot tentatively; we will only finalize after DocuSign completes.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP with timeline), SOW_Acme_v1.docx

Thanks — I'll coordinate gating steps once you confirm who needs to sign.

— Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
From: Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final acceptance gate, signature routing and proposed Day 1 start window

Jonas — thanks for the materials. Quick clarifying questions before I pull the approvals: 
1) On the acceptance criteria, can you add a short note about the long-tail latency measurement (how you compute 99th pctl on multi-region traffic)? Procurement will ask.
2) Our legal will want a clean redline of the SOW; do you have a version history or a single redline doc?

Procurement preference: single DocuSign packet routed to procurement@acmehealth.com, then to our Exec sponsor (Maya). But if Redwood needs a faster start we can do parallel signing; procurement just wants visibility.

I can confirm Exec availability (Maya) for a quick e-sign on Aug 6 if procurement can get their review done by Aug 5.

— Samir
Head of Platform Integrations
Acme Health
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 12:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final acceptance gate, signature routing and proposed Day 1 start window

Samir — thanks. Jonas: I've added a one-paragraph appendix describing our 99th pctl measurement (how we aggregate by region and weight by request count). I'll attach the short appendix and a single consolidated redline for the SOW (SOW_Acme_v1_redline.docx).

Operational proposals so we don't lose a slot:
- Option A (preferred): Procurement signs Aug 5, Exec (Maya) e-signs Aug 6 — DocuSign packet routed procurement -> exec. Day 1: week of Aug 11.
- Option B (fallback split): Exec verbal signoff Aug 6, procurement completes later; reserve Aug 11 slot tentatively and bump to Aug 18 if procurement pushes beyond Aug 9.

If you confirm Option A, Ben and I will prepare the DocuSign packet and lock the calendar. If Option B, we'll still prepare the packet but mark it as pending procurement signature.

Attachments referenced: MAP-approval-checklist.xlsx (approval owner matrix), SOW_Acme_v1_redline.docx (redlines).

— Camila
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 31 Jul 2025 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final acceptance gate, signature routing and proposed Day 1 start window

Samir — adding a couple of logistics notes from the onboarding ops side: 
- DocuSign templates: we can implement either routing flow. If procurement wants a single packet, please confirm the signer order (procurement first, then Maya). If you want Maya first, we can do that but procurement prefers visibility first.
- Start-of-service checklist: we'll need a primary POC for Day 0 (to run smoke tests) and a customer engineer for the ramp week; recommend naming those people in the DocuSign comments so we don't have to chase later.

If you confirm the signer order by EOD Aug 5, I'll send the DocuSign envelope and block calendar slots for Aug 11 (Day 1) and Aug 12-14 (ramp).

— Ben
Onboarding Lead
Redwood Dedicated Programs
